summary: Locale identifier consistency check. Builds a masked locale id as (a1 & 0x3FF) with bit 4 set in the second byte, queries locale info through the function pointer dword_8D3FB8 into a 120-byte stack buffer, then passes when the buffer hex-parses back to a1, when the match flag a2 is zero, or when the locale language string (dword_8D3FA8) is not purely alphabetical (CountAlphabeticalChars differs from Strlen). Returns 0 on an empty guard or query failure.

local_names.a2: match flag controlling whether the language-string alpha check is applied
local_names.v2: masked locale id (a1 & 0x3FF with 4 OR'd into the second byte) passed to the locale info query
local_names.v5: 120-byte stack buffer receiving the locale info query result
local_names.v3: result of CountAlphabeticalChars on the locale language string

operations.description: Masked locale id v2 computed as a1 & 0x3FF with 4 OR'd into the second byte
Locale info queried via function pointer dword_8D3FB8 with v2, 1, the 120-byte buffer v5 and length 120

Passes when the alpha count differs from the string length (non-alphabetical characters present)
Returns 1 on any pass condition, otherwise 0
